about: DEVBOARD-2 · every part of Steward, and the checks a person can do in under a minute in the demo org. A walk's check id lands in the area whose prefixes hold its letters (Prof4 → Profile); an unknown prefix lands in Unsorted. Map check ids are letters (Gift-A) so a walk's numbered check is never mistaken for one. `open` is a path in the app; `person` is a demo person's name, looked up in the demo org only.
fleetAbout: LEAD-IMPORT-1 · the QA fleet's five areas, as the lead summary names them in a fail ID (W-1107-Donors-12), and the Map area each one opens in. tokens are the spellings an ID may use.

checks.says: Home opens on one decision: a name, a reason and a step.
Click any figure on Home; the rows behind it open and add up to the figure.
Today's tasks on Home match the open tasks due today in Tasks.
Overdue things are brass, never red.
Search Margaret; Margaret Chen is the first row.
Sort by total giving; the biggest giver is on top and the sort survives a reload.
Move and resize a column; the table stays clean and readable.
The count over the table matches the rows when you scroll to the end.
Activity tab: Margaret Chen's timeline opens, newest first, and the right rail is on a contrasting ground.
Giving tab: lifetime on the rail equals the sum of the gifts listed.
Conversations tab: log a call; it shows at the top of the tab.
Emails tab: the tab opens and says plainly when no mailbox is connected.
Tasks tab: add a task due tomorrow; it shows here and in Tasks.
Notes tab: add a note; it is there after a reload.
Files tab: upload a small PDF; it lists with its name and size.
Record a $250 gift with an event on Isolde Fennimore; the event's Raised goes up by $250.
Double-click Save on a gift; exactly one gift is recorded.
Deposits: the open deposit's total equals the gifts in it.
To confirm: each gift waiting shows who, how much and why it waits.
Pledges lists each open pledge with what is still owed.
Record a payment on a pledge; its balance drops by that amount.
A pledge past due reads overdue in brass.
Every grant links to its funder's record.
An awarded grant counts as money promised; the total matches the awarded rows.
The next report deadline shows with its date and the grant it is for.
The gala opens with its date, its goal and what it has raised.
Raised on the gala equals the gifts attributed to it.
Add a guest; the guest count goes up by one.
Saturday clean-up shows its roles and how many are still needed.
Sign a volunteer up for a shift; the needed count drops by one.
A volunteer's hours on their record match their shifts.
The Annual Fund shows its goal and raised; raised opens the gifts behind it.
Journeys: each journey says who is on it and what the next step is.
Communications: a draft appeal opens and nothing sends without a person pressing Send.
Communications says plainly that the demo sends no mail.
Add a task due today; it shows in Tasks and on Home.
Tick a task done; it leaves the open list and the count drops by one.
Calendar shows the gala and this week's shifts on their days.
Open a report; each figure has its one sentence and opens its rows.
This year's total in Reports equals Home's for the same year.
Download the board report as a PDF; it opens and its totals match the screen.
Finance opens and its income equals the gifts for the same dates.
Restricted money is shown apart from unrestricted.
Each figure opens the rows behind it.
Data health lists possible duplicates, each with why it thinks so.
Merging a duplicate pair keeps one person with both gift histories.
Imports lists past imports with their row counts and an undo.
Atlas opens over any page and closes back to it.
Ask Atlas who has lapsed; it answers with names that open their records.
Atlas drafts and proposes; it never sends or saves money on its own.
Settings opens on the organization, with its name and timezone.
Team lists the director and the staff with their roles.
Connections says which are connected and which are not.
Change a setting and reload; the change stayed.
The giving page loads with the org's name and its amounts. Do not complete a payment.
Pick an amount and monthly; the button says the amount and how often.
Giving pages in Fundraising lists the page and its raised total.
Receipt settings show the legal name and the tax sentence.
A gift's receipt previews with the right amount and date.
Acknowledgments lists the gifts waiting for a thank-you.
/ops loads for a super-admin with every section, and says which source is down.
The Map tab lists every area and each check's last result.
A Fail here shows on the board within one reload.
